answers.core: Given that it concerns the inner workings of a Node and its usage of a method that can only be used internally, an Addon isn't really an option.
answers.workaround:
the documentation suggests using a texture with transparent padding at the edges to prevent the artifacts from occurring with linear filtering. But that would require adding the padding to every texture, so it isn't a really easy workaround. The other option would be to use a Material and disable repeat there. But using a material on a Sprite3d would also overwrite all other settings of the node, making it not really different from a MeshInstance3d.
And the whole point of Sprite3d is that it doesn't require adding a material and allows easy change of each parameter without affecting other instances that use the same material.
